project.name: UltraIa — Genesis Autonomous Engineering
project.description: AI that creates AI and learns from AI. This manifest is the executable operating contract: it does NOT replace the living systems below — it binds them into one autonomous loop.

objective.primary: Keep the project green and reduce known gaps: investigate → plan → implement → test → review → document → version → repeat.
success_criteria: All quality gates passing on every commit (evidence in loop-run-log.md)
Backlog STATE.md trending to zero pendientes
Every studied repository recorded in genesis/research-registry.json
Lessons persisted in learning/LEARNINGS.md after every iteration

maps_to.observe_understand: PIVR fase P pasos 1-3 (STATE.md + LEARNINGS + run-log + git status; NUNCA inventar estado)
maps_to.research: enlaces.txt protocolo + reach tools + pdfsearch + learning/sources/
maps_to.test_review: gates FULL CI order + loop-verifier opcional (APPROVE/REJECT)

stop_when: todas las tareas del backlog estan completadas
kill switch loop-pause-all activo en STATE.md o loop-run-log.md

opencode_map.director: agente piv-plan (read-only, decide que y quien, nunca edita)

mcp_registry.policy: maximo 5-10 MCP reales; preferir tools nativas ya integradas; instalar solo con capacidad que no exista localmente

native_replacements.web_search_fetch: tools websearch/webfetch + capability reach (r.jina.ai, DDG, Exa)

repositories.rule: todo repo externo estudiado queda registrado con decision integrate|adapt|study|reject + evidence; nunca reinvestigar lo mismo

memory.semantic_runtime: @ultraia/runtime MemoryManager (dedup sha256, half-life 7 dias) + qdrant memoria_experiencial_v2

execution.engine_cli: npm run genesis (vite-node scripts/genesis-run.ts: ciclo autonomo con gates reales)

security_rules: staging explicito: git add <archivos>, NUNCA git add . ni -A
no acciones destructivas sin autorizacion humana explicita
no exponer secretos; secrets enmascarados en disco (@ultraia/runtime UltraConfig)
verificar licencia antes de portar codigo externo (attribution header, implementacion ORIGINAL)
recovery_strategy: fail-soft por defecto; max 3 intentos de fix por item luego escalar a High Priority en STATE.md; cuarentena byte-exacta de WIP ajeno antes de gates FULL; restore-empty-tracked.ps1 ante mass-wipe
learning_strategy: bucle IA 4 fases (Sensado/Razonamiento/Accion/Ajuste); lecciones obligatorias en learning/LEARNINGS.md; verdad verificada separada de respuestas crudas (learning/truth vs learning/responses); autolearn detectGaps alimenta el siguiente ciclo

versioning.scheme: conventional commits feat|fix|chore(scope): desc, un commit por iteracion con pathspec
versioning.release: manual con aprobacion humana (sin semantica semver rigida todavia; package.json 0.1.0)

completion_conditions: backlog STATE.md sin filas pendientes ejecutables
research-registry sin entradas decision=study sin revisar hace >30 dias
criterios de exito de objective.primary medibles en run-log
